name: Carbon Ads
summary: Next.js component that renders a Carbon Ads unit styled to match your shadcn/ui theme.
description: Docs page for a shadcn-installable component that displays a Carbon Ads unit in Next.js apps: it refreshes the ad on client-side navigation, matches the shadcn/ui theme in light and dark mode, keeps the slot height while loading and hides itself when an ad blocker stops the script.
